purpose.domain_detail: SP2 GUI screen panel test program — exercises the SP2 windowing/screen library with panel ITS014
purpose.summary: A test/demo program that exercises the SP2 GUI screen library. It opens a window using SP2-OPEN-WINDOW, displays panel ITS014, converses with the user, and exits when the user presses Escape or closes the window. It wraps SP2 calls via a common COMPROC-CALL-SP2 paragraph using pointer-based parameter passing.
